source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将实，静压将裂
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC32 after EP02 SC31 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the brink where certainty and restraint can barely coexist into the next threshold: Keshadu is almost beyond concealment into open naming, Shisilang's fury threatens a real rupture, Tuobaye is functionally at the end of endurance, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly indistinguishable from imminent action.
title: 真相将实，静压将裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC31 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC31 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将明，十四郎怒线欲断，拓拔野只剩苦撑，白衣女子的静压已到将翻边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这根线推到几乎实质翻面。科沙度的判断几乎已经不再只是怀疑，十四郎的怒势也快让场面真正失控，拓拔野只剩最后一点硬撑的惯性。白衣女子的克制则到了几乎无法再称为克制的门槛。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将翻推进到几乎必须翻面的程度，为真正的出手或揭露做最后铺垫。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and contained until the true source beat forces the turn; avoid false spectacle before the real break.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to a real rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: public certainty, rupture-edge fury, exhausted endurance, and turning restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
